scientific_scope.object: conditional absolute loss difference between specified frozen programs
scientific_scope.primary_claim: positive mean gain in H and H greater than L in one qualified new within-site window

clock.release_constraint: strictly before next-stage first decision; point training before first forecast publication

instances.cost_aggregation: mean of fixed-instance losses on each common cell

P_summary_features: finite population std ddof0 of last6
exact six-step P difference when available
OLS P slope using >=2 finite values among last36
programs.fit_indices: seed-specific historical sampling without replacement; same rows for paired programs; use all if fewer than budget
programs.missingness: fit-stage finite column median, empty column constant0, missing indicators; no future fit
programs.persistence_raw: max(F-last finite arrivedP among36,0); if no finite history use D1 historicalP median; if absent qualification fails
programs.P_summary_missingness: mean/std finite entries; all missing NaN; exact delta needs both; OLS slope needs>=2 finite times
programs.point_imputer_fit_rows: only actual D0 model rows satisfying label-maturity-before-first-publication constraint

calibration.offset: higher quantile of S-raw_reserve on D2
calibration.selection: per recipe choose one q shared by five instances among historical risk-qualified q; minimum mean cost, tie smaller q

domain.threshold_weights: equal eligible input-valid turbine cells; no future target validity selection
domain.U: all other cells, including required-domain-input missing
domain.turbine_mix_scope: actual conditional population; not within-turbine causal contrast or common mechanism

interpretation.basis: operational composite input domains relative to frozen D4 input quantiles; no confirmation-window reranking
interpretation.H_description: historically relatively large negative six-step endpoint net change and historically relatively small absolute gap to forecast commitment
interpretation.L_description: historically relatively small absolute six-step endpoint net change and m at or above the fixed nonnegative threshold M75
interpretation.ordering_scope: conditional group means only; no per-time gain ranking or attribution to either grouping component alone

estimands.condition_population: declared chronology/context and common finite futureP; U remains in full risk population

risk.scope: each primary fixed instance on full scoring population

inference.method: shared circular UTC-day-block max absolute standardized envelope
inference.coverage: approximate under declared dependence conditions; no distribution-free guarantee

acceptance.primary_success: both cost directions and full-population risk gates pass

D3.purpose: historical q selection and P challenge

D4.purpose: input-only domain thresholds and exploratory forward d

confirmation.site: Hill of Towie for the currently defined within-site question
confirmation.source_change: new documented amendment before outcome access; never outcome-driven substitution
confirmation.unlock_gate: complete actual historical model/offset/threshold/config/source/source-exposure/calendar and implementation-inference qualification freeze; explicit future execution authorization still required

not_executed: raw measurement download or ZIP listing
